Name: Alternate Wizard portrait for Seasonal Outfits (Vanilla Game and SVE)
Author: astraltoast
Description:
There's not much to it, it's just a Wizard portrait made by me. It was made for Seasonal Outfits mods, as those are just portraits, you'll still need the original mod(s) for the sprites.

[b][u]Installation instructions:[/u]

[list]
[*]For Seasonal Outfits for SVE:
[/list][/b][list=1]
[*]Download the mod.
[*]Open the file for Seasonal Outfits For SVE mod.
[*]Go to "assets" and then "Portraits" folders.
[*]Drop down the "Magnus" and "Wizard" folders from my mod there. When ask to replace the files, confirm the choice.
[*]If you installed the mod correctly, those two folders will now have the new portrait pngs in them. "Wizard" folder should contain four images, for every season, each with two expressions and "Magnus" folder should contain five images (for each season and for flower dance), each with six expressions and one pink hair version.
[/list][list]
[*][b]For Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic:[/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*] Download the mod.
[*]Open the file for Seasonal Outfits mod.
[*]Go to "assets" and then "Portraits" folders.
[*]Drop down the "Wizard" folder from my mod there. You don't need the "Magnus" one, it's just for the SVE version. When asked to replace the files, confirm the choice.
[*]If you installed the mod correctly, this folder will now have the new portrait pngs in them. "Wizard" folder should contain four images, for every season, each with two expressions.

[/list]
[u]Compatibility:[/u] Should be compatible with everything that the main mod is compatible with, as it just replaces the images for portraits, there's no additional code there. It doesn't require anything additional to handle the portraits, as they're made in original portraits resolution (64x64).

If you update or reinstall the original Seasonal Outfits mods, you'll have to reinstall this mod as well.

I also recommend checking out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000?tab=posts&jump_to_comment=145312389&BH=0]Romanceable Rasmodius - SVE Compatible[/url] mod, as I've made those assets for my personal use along with this mod, so far I think my portraits work quite well with this mod.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the few pixels that got out of place on my portraits due to me messing up my layer order lol
